{
  "need": "Competence",
  "secondary": { "name": "Status" },
  "read": "Freezing in the big moment and then beating yourself up is a competence threat wearing a status mask — they're not just disappointed they underperformed, they're afraid this moment defines what kind of player they are. The self-criticism is actually an attempt to signal they know better, to protect whatever respect they think they just lost.",
  "pull": { "collapse": "Protector", "instinct": "Rush in with reassurance — 'it's fine, don't worry about it' — which feels kind but quietly signals you don't believe they can handle honest reflection, and it leaves them alone with the real fear." },
  "mentorMove": "Sit with them in the discomfort just long enough to name it without flinching, then redirect the story: the freeze is the brain doing something real and fixable, not evidence they don't belong here.",
  "holdFirm": ["We are going to talk about what happened — not to punish, but because you're capable of learning from it and I won't pretend otherwise.", "The standard for how we respond to hard moments stays the same: we face it, we work it, we come back."],
  "stayFlexible": ["How you process it is up to you — some players want to talk it through right now, some want reps first, and both are fine.", "We can find the specific trigger and build a routine around it, whether that's a reset cue, a breathing pattern, or a different pre-play focus — your call on what fits you."],
  "forceLevel": { "level": 1, "label": "Empathy" },
  "script": [
    { "phase": "Connection", "words": "Hey. Come here a second. I saw that, and I'm not going anywhere — you're still my player, same as ten minutes ago." },
    { "phase": "Curiosity", "words": "Tell me what it felt like right before. Not what happened on the field — what was going on inside you, like three seconds before you had to go?" },
    { "phase": "Collaboration", "words": "That's your nervous system flooding you, and it happens to players at every level — it's not a character flaw, it's a signal we haven't trained that specific situation enough yet. So let's figure out what we build into practice so your body knows exactly what to do when it shows up again." },
    { "phase": "Commitment", "words": "I'm going to hold you to performing in those moments because I have high standards for you and I genuinely believe you can get there — this is one data point, not your ceiling. What's the first thing you want to work on?" }
  ],
  "longGame": "Over the next few weeks, engineer smaller high-pressure reps in practice — close-game simulations, eyes-on-you moments — so they accumulate proof that they can execute when it counts. Each one builds the neural pattern that says the spotlight is fuel, not a threat."
}
situation: One of my players froze in the big moment and is now down on themselves.
